name: KontextBench
intro: KontextBench 是 FLUX.1 Kontext 论文提出的上下文图像生成与编辑基准，包含 108 张基础图像和 1,026 个独特图像—提示词对，覆盖局部编辑、全局编辑、文字编辑、风格参考和角色参考五类真实使用场景。
build_method: 众包真实用例与人工整理
metric: 人工任务评分, AuraFace 相似度, 中位延迟
task_type: 图像编辑, 图像参考生成
eval_feature: 单轮编辑, 多轮一致性
scale: 1,026 个图像—提示词对 / 108 张基础图像
build_method_en: Crowdsourced real-world use cases and human curation
intro_en: KontextBench is the in-context image generation and editing benchmark introduced with FLUX.1 Kontext. It contains 108 base images and 1,026 unique image-prompt pairs across local editing, global editing, text editing, style reference, and character reference tasks collected from real use cases.
metric_en: Human task scores, AuraFace similarity, median latency
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2506.15742v2 Sections 4.1–4.3 and the official black-forest-labs/kontext-bench dataset snapshot fb9b2cb. The diagram records the crowd-sourced real-world use cases, 108-base-image pool, image-to-multiple-prompt pairing, and exact five-category counts: 416 local, 262 global, 92 text, 63 style-reference, and 193 character-reference pairs, totaling 1,026. It does not invent an unreported annotation or filtering protocol. Evaluation follows the paper's human image-quality and editing-task assessment, AuraFace facial-embedding similarity for character reference, median image-to-image latency, and multi-turn character consistency and drift analysis.
